messages:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident triggered: PD#INC-4321 — gpu-swap-pressure detected on pool-gamma. Alert: cuda_alloc_failed (ENOSPACE_SWAP) x 23 in 5m. Affected hosts: gpu-8c-03, gpu-8c-09. Severity: P1. link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-4321
samira: acked on PD. I'm looking. Any customer reports?
matt: saw a couple 503s from hosted API in metrics dashboard around -2m. Error spikes correlate with that pool.
kevin: checking node logs now, looks like 'Out of memory: KSM pages exceeded' + swap usage jumping to 94% on gpu-8c-03. Suspect cgroup swap throttling + heavy kv-cache fragmentation.
priya: can we flip auto-shedder to aggressive for pool-gamma? If we shed long-tail requests might stop the thrash.
samira: good idea. matt you can run the shed command? runbook: https://wiki/redwood/oncall/gpu-swap-runbook
matt: running: 
```
./manage-pool --pool pool-gamma --set-shedding aggressive --reason 'swap-pressure PD' 
```
matt: command returned ok, shedding enabled for pool-gamma :thumbsup:
kevin: continuing log tail, also seeing CUDA driver warnings: 'cuMemAlloc retry failed: out of memory (err 2)'. Some pods restarted by kube. Pod list: gpu-runner-13, kvcache-hot-21.
priya: can we cordon gpu-8c-03 and drain, evict the worst offenders? we should avoid mass restarts causing more thrash.
samira: agree, but let's drain gpu-8c-09 first (higher swap). matt can you do a gentle drain (graceful eviction) on 8c-09?
matt: starting graceful drain: `kubectl drain gpu-8c-09 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120` — moving jobs off.
oncall-bot: Note: auto-retry for requests to pool-gamma is enabled; fallback routing to pool-beta will be applied for 10m.
kevin: after enabling shedding and starting drain, swap usage on 8c-09 dropped from 94% -> 60% in ~90s. Error rate on API also trending down.
priya: customer impact: ~2% increased error rate for hosted API across eu-region for ~3 minutes during peak, now recovering. No SEV reported by CS yet.
samira: ok for now. I'm going to page infra-sre to review kernel tuning for swap and kvcache limits. kevin, please collect `dmesg` and `nvidia-smi` logs and attach to PD.
kevin: attaching logs to PD: /attachments/INC-4321/logs.tar.gz
pagerduty: INC-4321 acknowledged by samira at 1755551240. Assigned to oncall/infra-sre.
matt: monitoring for 10m, will uncordon if stable.
priya: brainstorming: longer-term we may want to disable host swap on these GPU nodes or tune `MemorySwapiness` for cgroups. filing follow-up ticket.
samira: filing follow-up: https://jira.redwood/browse/ENGINFRA-2219 — include kv-cache fragmentation hypotheses.
oncall-bot: Incident updated: mitigation applied (aggressive shedding + node drain). Recommend Postmortem after 48h if any regressions.
kevin: last check: API error spike back to baseline, no further cuda_alloc failures in last 5m.
samira: handing off to night oncall (priya) at 1755551400 — putting thread into follow-up monitoring. Thanks everyone :heart:
priya: acked handoff. I'll watch through the night and escalate if anything recurs.
